title: Android Wear IOB not available
symptom: User is using xDrip on phone and Android Wear (Huawei Smartwatch 2) and cannot get IOB (Insulin on Board) value on the watchface, although it is shown in the xDrip app. They ask if there is any way to get it on the watchface.
evidence_quote: I now have informations about my estimated A1c etc as a toast message, but I haven't found a way to get my current IoB!
